name: Blueberries

pros.title: easy to use as a whole food
pros.explanation: Simple, recognisable, and realistic for everyday eating.

pros.title: one of the clearest antioxidant-identity fruits
pros.explanation: Blueberries have a stronger cultural and practical antioxidant case than a generic fruit baseline.

pros.title: hydrating whole-fruit package
pros.explanation: Water and whole-food structure make it easier to use well than juice or sweets.

cons.title: small berries disappear quickly
cons.explanation: The handful format can make portions less obvious.

cons.title: satiety is not especially strong
cons.explanation: Fruit often needs help from the rest of the meal.

cons.title: sweet format can stack up fast
cons.explanation: Small-looking portions can still push a meal away from the cleaner use case.
